items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: One night, Tatum was in town down at the Three Deuces, and he actually brought this man by. ... I grabbed and hugged him and told him how much I loved him. ... We played from 9 to 1.

ctx.x: So you started playing piano before you started playing saxophone. You were proficient on piano before saxophone?
Sure, I could run up and down everything. They used to call me Runs. I was a great admirer of Art Tatum
Who wasn’t? Art Tatum was the man.
